notes: Source: Morocco eAIP (ONDA SIA) AD 2 GMMX; pages carry mixed dates, latest seen 04 SEP 2025 (AIRAC AMDT 09/25), others 26 DEC 2024 (AMDT 13/24) and 28 DEC 2023 (AMDT 13/23). The AIC A01/26 checklist (09 Jan 2026) was opened but lists no AD 2 page dates, so it could not confirm that no later amendment changed GMMX. The AD 2 text seen gives no curfew or night ban (ATS H24); curfew left out rather than recorded as none. The 'night stop' authorisation is about aircraft staying overnight; the AIP says scheduled and Royal liaison flights are not affected. Fire category CAT 9. AD 2.20: aircraft over 35 t must make the 180° turn on the turn-around area at the runway end. AD 2.23: stands A2, A4 and A6 can't be used by A319; stands F1A/F1B for code A or B aircraft only. IATA not shown in the AIP; the ONDA airport pages (onda.ma) could not be opened. Quotes taken via a page-reading tool; the AD 2.3 hours were asked for verbatim and returned as 'MON-FRI : 0830-1630 (local time)'.
